conbody.p: Fields represent the contractual terms and metadata from your contract record in Conga CLM. They are also called "merge fields". When you generate a contract document, the values of the fields are retrieved from the contract record and populated in the document. As a template administrator, you are responsible for building your template to include fields, as static text, as read-only fields or as smart fields that can be changed and reconciled to the contract record during the negotiation process.
Following sections explain how you can use fields in your contract template:
